Package org.apache.hadoop.hbase.io

Class MetricsIO.NoOpMetricsIOSource

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.hbase.io.MetricsIO.NoOpMetricsIOSource
All Implemented Interfaces:
MetricsIOSource, BaseSource
Enclosing class:
MetricsIO
static final class MetricsIO.NoOpMetricsIOSource extends Object implements MetricsIOSource
A MetricsIOSource that discards all updates. Used while IO metrics are disabled, or when the real metrics source could not be created.
